prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: The posting asks for a Solutions Architect who can design integration blueprints and also ship full-stack, AI-integrated tools. I have done both. I am a systems architect focused on AI automation and agent engineering, with 4+ years building full-stack platforms, business automation tools, and AI agent workflows.

The posting asks for working experience with Python and with LLM integration through APIs. I built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that scores job postings against an evidence base using RAG on pgvector and drafts tailored documents behind a human approval step. I shipped it with FastAPI, Langfuse tracing, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI covering 70 tests and an eval gate. I also built tycodes-pipeline, a staged Python pipeline that tests whether Google AI answers name local businesses, with draft-only outreach behind human approval. On the customer side, I designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform, and I architected linkme-intops, a React and TypeScript CRM module on Cloudflare Workers.

The gap I have is SaaS and IPaaS work in an enterprise setting. My enterprise integration work has been custom ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, reducing service delivery times by over 30%, but I have not built on a commercial SaaS or IPaaS platform inside a company. To close that, I would start by building one connector between a SaaS tool and a business system in the first few weeks, then document the design so your team can check it.
Could we talk this week about the integration and onboarding work on your team? I can walk through the Job Fit Agent build and how I would approach a client integration.
